channel.title: LEHS Data Dive — What's New
channel.description: Updates to the Lynn English High School data dashboard.

item.title: FY2025 spending and mid-2026 housing now in
item.description: School and district expenditure files now include FY2025 (LEHS per-pupil spending is in the dashboard through that year), and the Lynn housing series is refreshed through July 2026. Year labels on MCAS, English Learners, Teachers, and About the Data now follow the latest year in each dataset, so the next DESE release will show up without a copy edit. Spring 2026 MCAS, 2026 graduation rates, and 2026–27 October enrollment are not public yet.

item.title: 2026 accountability targets now live
item.description: SY2025-26 is closed. DESE's July 31 release of the 2026 Accountability Targets and 2027 Increments workbook is now in the dashboard — the State Accountability page shows the newest baselines and next-year steps for each indicator and student group.

item.title: New pages: Lynn HS Options, Wellbeing, Feeder Schools, and more
item.description: A big additions release: a side-by-side of Lynn's public high schools, a student & community wellbeing page, feeder-middle-school profiles with an enrollment projection, a "what changed this year" overview, a data-gaps and corrections log, Stories, and a housing-affordability section.

item.title: Accessibility & convenience: dark mode, Spanish switcher, search, shareable links
item.description: The dashboard now has a dark theme, a Spanish/English language switcher, site-wide search, shareable URLs that remember your filter selections, and a one-click School Committee PDF briefing.

item.title: State Accountability deep-dive
item.description: The State Accountability page now breaks down how the determination is built, where LEHS sits statewide by percentile, what next year's targets require, and the long-run trend behind each indicator.
